title: Demo publica y captura de leads: auto-registro hibrido con Google Auth
description: Flujo de entrada para prospectos lookalike: mantener auto-registro habilitado, rol/estado por defecto (demo/trial) para nuevos usuarios, redirigir tras login a chat demo interactivo donde el bot demuestra capacidades, y paywall de modo demo con CTA a activacion por invitacion.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX complexity. Complexity drivers: 8 files affected, schema changes required, AI behaviour changes, security implications, cross-cutting (multi-domain), category requires council. Required agents (10): architect, database, backend, frontend, ai_engineer, performance, security, qa, release, memory_engineer.

decisions.rationale: Approved: profiles table design is minimal and multi-tenant safe; trigger pattern is standard Supabase; demo route stays behind admin client.
Approved: new 017 migration only, immutable migrations respected; RLS per-owner; CHECK constraint widened to add demo request_type (fixes latent 23514 bug).
Approved: admin client for writes, server for reads; input validation preserved; AI usage tracked; rate limit per user persisted.
Approved: reuses existing DemoPage/ChatWindow patterns; paywall as small client component; no business logic in UI.
Approved: no hardcoded knowledge; demo persona from DB (Luna); prompt unchanged; token tracking already present in demo route.
Approved: single profile upsert per chat request (one RPC/query); in-memory map removed for authed users; env-configurable limit.
Approved: RLS per-owner profiles, no cross-tenant access; admin client server-side only; no secrets; rate limiting prevents abuse.
Approved: feature and the demo request_type CHECK bug fix will be recorded in engineering memory.
Approved: atomic commits with conventional format; working tree clean and synced before completion; no secrets committed.
Approved: gates lint+build+typecheck+e2e+devtools will run before complete; existing public demo behavior preserved.

qualityGateResults.output: Demo chat, lead login redirect, paywall verified in browser; console clean
RLS per-owner profiles; admin client server-side only; no secrets committed
src/ clean; pre-existing failures in tests/ (commit bff027b, untouched)
Single atomic RPC per chat request; env-configurable limit
